question: Raman can do a piece of work in 8 days, Sanam and Aman together can do the same work in 6 days, while Raman and Aman together can do it in 4 days. How long will Sanam alone take to do the work?
solution:
Given:

Raman can do a piece of work in 8 days, Sanam and Aman together can do the same work in 6 days, while Raman and Aman together can do it in 4 days. 

Concept used:

If A and B alone can complete a task in X and Y days respectively, then they together will take = XY/(X + Y) days to complete the work.

Calculation:

Let's suppose, Aman and Sanam can do the work individually in x and y days respectively.

According to the concept,

(8x)/(8 + x) = 4

⇒ 8x = 32 + 4x

⇒ 4x = 32

⇒ x = 8

So, Aman can do the work in 8 days, working alone.

According to the concept,

(8y)/(8 + y) = 6

⇒ 8y = 48 + 6y

⇒ 2y = 48

⇒ y = 24

**∴ Sanam alone will take 24 days to do the work.**
